title.narrative: Climate Resilient Rice Commercialization Sector Development Program

description.narrative: The Climate Resilient Rice Commercialization Sector Development Program (SDP) is proposed to support and accelerate the efficient and effective implementation of the Strategy on Agriculture and Water (SAW) and the Policy on the Promotion of Paddy Production and Rice Export (the Rice Policy). It will address food security and rice commercialization by prioritizing: (i) strengthening the rice value chain; (ii) improving the legal and regulatory framework in agricultural land management; (iii) improving access to credit by paddy producers and rice millers/exporters; and (iv) enhancing paddy production and productivity through improved irrigation water use efficiency, establishment of paddy post-harvesting facilities, and paddy crop insurance pilots. The SDP will (i) address major strategic thrusts of the 2011-2013 Country Partnership Strategy, and sector strategies and roadmap; and (ii) complement the on-going sector initiatives by emphasizing the commercialization aspects of rice.

Output: Conducive legal and regulatory environment established to facilitate climate-resilient rice commercialization Indicator: Milled rice standards and trade facilitation measures in place (on-track) Progress/Status: Achieved.
The key policy and legal reforms included (i) approval and issuance of Cambodian standards on milled rice by Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy (MIME) in 2012 and update by Ministry of Industry and Handicraft (MIH) in 2014; (ii) approval and issuance of Prakas by the Senior Minister, Minister of MIH on establishment of 2 Cambodian standards, standard for Phka Rumduol rice and standard for Phka Chan Sen Sar rice; (iii) approval and issuance of the law on the management of pesticides and fertilizers by the government; and (iv) preparation and submission of a draft law on plant protection and quarantine by MAFF to the Council of Ministers (COM).
The draft law was passed by the National Assembly and by the Senate, and approved and signed into law by His Majesty, the King of Cambodia on 3 May 2022. Data Source: Tranche compliance reports prepared by the executing agency Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y

Output: Conducive legal and regulatory environment established to facilitate climate-resilient rice commercialization Indicator: Policy and regulatory framework for local seed production are in place (achieved) Progress/Status: Achieved.
First Tranche and Second Tranche conditions were complied with. First tranche was released on 19 December 2013 and second tranche was released on 26 August 2022. The policy-based loan (L-3006) was closed on 31 August 2022.
The key policy and legal reforms included, (i) approval by the Minister of MAFF of the Seed Policy for Cambodia; (ii) approval by the Director General, General Directorate of Agriculture (GDA) of MAFF of the National Seed Standards; (iii) approval and issuance of Prakas by the Minister of MAFF on Procedures for Providing Seed Quality Certification; (iv) approval and issuance by the Director General, GDA of MAFF of the General Introduction to the Examination of Distinctiveness, Uniformity and Stability (DUS) of New Varieties of Plants; and (v) approval and issuance of the Guidelines for the Conduct of Tests for DUS of Rice by the Director General, GDA of MAFF. Data Source: Tranche compliance reports prepared by the executing agency Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y
